title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This note reads the engines' own state from the running record. Every position described here is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single trade says nothing about a strategy. The live starts are v005 from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The initial live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losing trades were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions and recent closes

The live snapshot shows no open paper positions in htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, or trend-daily-v006. htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 remains open. ATOM already closed at 1.703 on 18 October 2026 after entering at 2.066 on 10 October 2026. These figures are measurements of realised paper outcomes under each engine's rules. They describe what happened in the recorded period, not what must happen next. With 0 positions open in those engines at the snapshot, there is no live paper exposure in them at that moment, while the NEAR position continues to carry the open paper exposure described in the record.

## Market filter status

The Bitcoin market filter is off for trend-daily-v005. The Bitcoin market filter is also off for trend-daily-v006. With the filter off, the engines are not taking new trend entries under that condition. For both trend-daily engines, the closest names to their 20-day breakout are the same in the snapshot: AVAXUSDT is 6.73% below its high, TRXUSDT is 10.05% below its high, and BNBUSDT is 10.54% below its high. Those distances are measurements of how far each name sits from its 20-day breakout level at the read time. They do not say whether a breakout will occur, and they do not create a signal by themselves. They only show the current distance in the paper record.

## What the record does and does not show

The record shows paper signals only. It shows closed paper trades, open paper positions, and the state of the Bitcoin market filter. It does not show real orders, real fills, or real account changes. The closed-trade averages are small-count measurements, and a single trade says nothing about a strategy. The ATOM loss of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip is a recorded paper outcome, not a verdict on the rule that produced it. The NEAR position remains open, so its outcome is not yet measured. The v007 average is null, which means the recorded average net per trade is not a usable number in this snapshot. The trend engines' negative averages are realised paper results from the recorded starts on 1 October 2026 and 9 October 2026. They are not proof of failure and not proof of future behaviour.

## Where the numbers are and when they were read

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-12T21:01:21.978Z. The record updates continuously, so the open positions, closed-trade counts, averages, market filter state, and breakout distances can change after that read time. A later read may show a different count, a different average, a different filter state, or a different distance for AVAXUSDT, TRXUSDT, or BNBUSDT. The article reports the record as it stood at the stated read time and does not project from it.
